content.description: Transmission case placed on cylindrical stand showing internal view with components visible

content.text: Place the transmission on a cylindrical stand for more efficient work.
Place shop rags between the case and stand to avoid damaging the case.

content.description: Internal view of transmission case showing thrust washer and bearing installation location with directional arrow indicating downward cup side

content.text: Install the thrust washer, facing the cup side downward.

content.description: Two views: left shows brake piston No. 3 circular component, right shows internal case view with piston location marked

content.text: Install the tube aligning its locking tab (part A) with part B of the case.
Make sure that the lips of the tube end are completely inserted onto the outer piston.

content.description: Two views: left shows output shaft assembly being inserted, right shows circular view of case with clutch plates and alignment points A and B marked

content.text: 4. PARTIALLY INSERT OUTPUT SHAFT ASSEMBLY INTO CASE
Align the opening notch (part A) of the clutch plates with the slot (part B) of the case.

content.description: Left shows detailed cross-section of groove measurement with arrows, right shows internal case view with clutch pack location

content.text: With the case in upright position, make sure that the clutch pack is lower than the ledge below the snap ring groove. If the clutch pack is not lower than the ledge, components may be misassembled or there may be excess ATF on the discs.
